bugs.error_message: TypeError: Invalid URL at new URL(SITE_URL) in layout
bugs.root_cause: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL= empty in .env; `??` keeps empty string
Tailwind v4 max-w-* also reads --spacing-*; --spacing-wrap (template) won over --container-wrap

bugs.error_message: next build: Error occurred prerendering page /sitemap.xml (Dataset not found)
bugs.root_cause: sitemap used client.fetch (throws) and only listed CMS pages
bugs.fix: safeFetch + static Advertisr routes, CMS pages that collide with static paths skipped

bugs.error_message: Parsing CSS source code failed: Unexpected token BadUrl(data:image/svg+xml…)
bugs.root_cause: Arbitrary bg-[url("data:…")] class produced invalid CSS; stale in dev cache after removal
bugs.fix: Replaced with inline <svg> Tick; cleared .next/dev; added @source not "../../design"

bugs.error_message: Error parsing: app/package.json (tsx/next fail to start)
bugs.root_cause: Regex removal of scripts left a trailing comma after the last script
bugs.fix: Removed the comma; validate with node -e require

bugs.error_message: Property '_id' does not exist on type '({ _key } & CaseStudyReference) | {...}'
bugs.root_cause: Typegen can't narrow `_type in [...] => {}` conditional projections, so resolved and unresolved shapes unioned
bugs.fix: One conditional per block type (caseCards, caseList) sharing a projection string

bugs.root_cause: Nav set CTA href from a DOM lookup inside useEffect
bugs.fix: href=/groeiplan + onClick that scrolls to #groeiplan when the page has it

bugs.root_cause: Python str.replace replaced every occurrence when adapting the test to the removed SITE_DEFAULTS
bugs.fix: Restored addressCountry in the CMS-merged expectation

bugs.error_message: npm ci EUSAGE: Missing @emnapi/core@2.0.0-beta.2 / @emnapi/runtime from lock file (Deploy Sanity Studio action)
bugs.root_cause: Lockfile written by npm 11 (local Node 24) omits deps of optional @rolldown/binding-wasm32-wasi; npm 10 (Node 22 on CI) treats that as out of sync. Regenerating the lockfile doesn't help.
bugs.fix: CI node-version 22 -> 24 so CI uses npm 11 like local. Repro: npx npm@10 ci --dry-run in studio/

bugs.error_message: Kennisbank search and category pills don't filter; always all articles
bugs.root_cause: Search input and Pills were visual-only placeholders (ponytail comment in ArticleIndex). First fix unmounted empty sections, and remounted .rv elements stayed opacity 0 because SiteEffects observes .rv once per pathname.
bugs.fix: ArticleFilter context (q + category) in kennisbank.tsx; FilterItem/FilterGroup/FilterEmpty hide via className 'contents'/'hidden', never unmount. New articleIndex.noResults field.
